day_shape: CENTCOM launched self-defence strikes on Iran after a downed US Apache over Hormuz, OFAC published Iran-related GLs U and V, UNSC split over reinstated Iran sanctions, IDF struck Hezbollah sites in Tyre and evacuated villages north of the Litani.

threads.label: US strikes Iran after Apache downing
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced self-defence strikes against Iran beginning 5pm ET, framed as a proportional response to the downing of a US Army Apache helicopter over the Strait of Hormuz. Trump accused Iran of responsibility and vowed retaliation; IRIB circulated imagery it said showed an IRGC air-defence shootdown of a US MQ-9 drone.

threads.label: US-Iran nuclear negotiations track
threads.summary: VP JD Vance said a long-term US-Iran nuclear agreement is nearing fruition within weeks or months, with the NYT reporting Iran would dilute rather than hand over its uranium stockpile. Iran International reported Tehran pushed back on a reported US plan to use frozen Iranian assets to compensate Gulf states.

threads.label: UN Security Council Iran sanctions split
threads.summary: The Security Council's permanent members remained divided over whether reinstated UN sanctions on Iran are in force, with Liberia warning of an oversight vacuum and calling for a Secretariat-led reporting mechanism. UK Chargé d'Affaires James Kariuki delivered a statement insisting on full and effective implementation of the reinstated sanctions.

threads.label: OFAC publishes Iran-related general licenses
threads.summary: The US Treasury's OFAC published Iran-related Web General Licenses U and V in the Federal Register, having previously made them available online. OFAC also published Venezuela Sanctions Regulations General Licenses 48A and 49A the same day.

threads.label: IDF operations against Hezbollah in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck six Hezbollah sites in Tyre and additional infrastructure in southern Lebanon, with Givati Brigade troops north of the Litani locating weapons depots including anti-tank missiles and drones. IDF Arabic spokesman Adraee issued urgent evacuation warnings for Ansariyah, Ghassanieh and Homin al-Fauqa; Chief of Staff Zamir said the IDF was postured to strike Iran again.

threads.label: Lebanon border incidents and Israeli casualties
threads.summary: A gunman infiltrated from Lebanon, opened fire on IDF troops near Margaliot and was shot dead; the IDF said he did not cross the border fence and his affiliation was undetermined. Capt. Shahar Gamla, 23, died from wounds sustained by an explosive drone in Lebanon, and one Hezbollah rocket at troops was intercepted near Kiryat Shmona.

threads.label: Gaza talks and Hamas finance strike
threads.summary: Gaza talks hosted by Egypt stalled with Hamas disarmament cited as the sole remaining sticking point, and Fatah boycotted Cairo talks while senior Fatah official Jibril Rajoub rejected a technocratic committee plan. The IDF and Shin Bet said a Sunday strike in northern Gaza killed Hamas funds-transfer chief Khader Jamasi and deputy Muhammad Harazin, accused of moving tens of millions of dollars.
